description: This bar chart illustrates the average JGA score for two models, LLaMA-7B and T5-small, across different turn IDs. The horizontal axis represents “Turn ID”, with categories labeled 0 through 26 in sequential order, and is a categorical axis. The vertical axis represents “Avg. JGA Score”, with a linear scale ranging from 0.2 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. For each turn ID, there are two bars representing the JGA score for each model. The LLaMA-7B model is represented by orange bars, while the T5-small model is represented by yellow bars. The LLaMA-7B bars generally range in height from approximately 0.7 to 0.9, with the tallest bar at Turn ID 0 reaching a value of 0.92 and the shortest bar at Turn ID 24 reaching a value of 0.71. The T5-small bars range in height from approximately 0.4 to 0.8, with the tallest bar at Turn ID 2 reaching a value of 0.76 and the shortest bar at Turn ID 26 reaching a value of 0.33. The bars are arranged in pairs, grouped by Turn ID, and are sorted sequentially by Turn ID. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
